problem_understanding.task_summary: Regression task to predict house sale price (SalePrice) from residential property attributes in the Ames Housing dataset.
risks: Missing values in multiple features, especially LotFrontage, Alley, MasVnrType, MasVnrArea, basement fields, FireplaceQu, garage fields, PoolQC, Fence, and MiscFeature
High missingness in PoolQC (998/1460 train, 999/1459 test), MiscFeature (957 train, 962 test), Alley (935 train, 923 test), and Fence (806 train, 808 test)
Test set contains missing values in columns such as MSZoning, Utilities, Exterior1st, Exterior2nd, basement size/bath fields, KitchenQual, and Functional
Small training dataset with 1,460 rows and 79 explanatory variables plus target
Many categorical features with string dtype require encoding
problem_understanding.business_goal_summary: The business goal is to predict the final sale price of each house using property characteristics. Accurate SalePrice predictions support residential property valuation and submission generation for each test Id.

steps.reasoning: Engineered features mix numeric columns (with residual missingness like MasVnrArea, GarageYrBlt) and categorical columns (MSZoning, Street, Alley, SaleType, etc.). Median imputation + standardization keeps numeric features model-friendly for linear baselines, while one-hot encoding with most_frequent imputation handles categorical columns robustly without leaking the target.
Align scoring with the resolved target contract primary metric so model selection optimizes the same objective used for evaluation.

Step: drop_columns.reasoning: Drop non-target columns that are almost entirely missing.

Step: fill_missing.reasoning: Impute observed missing values with a conservative default strategy.

Step: create_interaction.reasoning: Create a quality-by-living-area interaction so the model can express that size matters more for higher-quality homes.

Step: encode_categorical.reasoning: One-hot encode Neighborhood so its categorical location signal can be used by downstream models without imposing ordinality.
